main.description: Configuration for the author's now page. Singleton record with rkey 'self'. Configures which ATProto collections to query for 'recent items' panels alongside the latest social.crate.now entry.

liveFeeds.description: Ordered list of live feed panels to render alongside the now page. Each entry points at an ATProto collection on some author's PDS and pulls the most recent N records.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this config was first created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the most recent edit to this config.

liveFeed.description: A single live feed panel on the now page.

title.description: Display title for the panel (e.g. 'Recent Bluesky posts', 'In progress on Collective').

did.description: Author DID to query. Defaults to the now page owner's own DID when omitted.

limit.description: Number of most recent records to fetch (default 5).

filter.description: Optional renderer-side filter. 'topLevelPosts' (alias 'noReplies') drops app.bsky.feed.post records that have a reply field. 'noReposts' drops repost records when present.
